defs.def: the size or extent of sth, especially when compared with sth else （尤指与其他事物相比较时的）规模，范围，程度

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D打印出现了一个新的前沿领域，正开始受到关注：食品。近期的发展使能够大规模打印、烹饪并供应食物的机器成为可能。而该行业并未止步于此。

ex.s: And unplanned human activities have proved the idea of top﹣down control by top predators to be true． In the ocean， we fished for top predators such as cod on an industrial scale， while on land， we killed off large predators such as wolves． These actions have greatly affected the ecological balance．
ex.t: 而人类无计划的活动已经证明了顶级捕食者自上而下控制的观点是正确的。在海洋中，我们以工业规模捕捞鳕鱼等顶级捕食者，而在陆地上，我们消灭了狼等大型捕食者。这些行为极大地影响了生态平衡。

ex.s: They are ideal on a small scale; one can have solar panels on the roof, but not a coal power station in the kitchen!
ex.t: 它们是小规模的理想选择；屋顶上可以安装太阳能电池板，但厨房里不能安装燃煤发电站！

ex.s: He has been working as a 3personwho studiesbiologyforthepast10 years.Hewas4 indue courseappointedastheteam leader of a very large scale cancer treatment programme.
ex.t: 他一直从事3个人的工作，他研究生物学10年。 他被指定领导一个大规模癌症治疗方案。

defs.def: a range of levels or numbers used for measuring sth 等级；级别
the set of all the different levels of sth, from the lowest to the highest 等级体系
a series of marks at regular intervals on an instrument that is used for measuring 标度；刻度
an instrument for weighing people or things 秤；磅秤；天平

ex.s: Do you have scales to weigh the flesh?

defs.def: the relation between the actual size of sth and its size on a map, diagram or model that represents it 比例；比例尺
a series of musical notes moving upwards or downwards, with fixed intervals between each note, especially a series of eight starting on a particular note 音阶
any of the thin plates of hard material that cover the skin of many fish and reptiles 鳞；鳞片

ex.s: The terraces got the name because they look like a dragon's scales, while the mountain ridge looks like its backbone.
ex.t: 梯田之所以有这个名字，是因为它们看起来像龙的鳞片，而山脊则看起来像它的骨干。

ex.s: The green lizards adapted quickly over a relatively short time of 15 years, and now they have bigger pads on their toes and stickier scales to help them stay high in the trees – and well away from their troublesome neighbours!
ex.t: 绿色蜥蜴在15年这样相对较短的时间内迅速适应了，现在它们脚趾上的肉垫更大，鳞片黏性更强，帮助它们待在高处的树上——远离那些麻烦的邻居！

defs.def: a hard greyish-white substance that is sometimes left inside water pipes and containers for heating water 水垢；水锈
a hard substance that forms on teeth, especially when they are not cleaned regularly 牙垢；牙石
to climb to the top of sth very high and steep 攀登；到达 … 顶点
to remove the small flat hard pieces of skin from a fish 去鳞
to remove tartar from the teeth by scraping 刮除牙石
to change the size of sth 改变 … 的大小
